description: Batch job nightly_claims_load failed with connection timeout error while writing to claims_processing database
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion during peak nightly batch window
resolution: Increased connection pool size from 10 to 25 and staggered batch job start times

description: Underwriting exception queue stuck, batch job underwriting_risk_scoring timed out connecting to database
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion, same root cause as INC-001
resolution: Applied same connection pool fix as INC-001

description: Policy renewal batch job failed overnight, database connections exhausted during month end processing
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion during month-end peak load
resolution: Temporary workaround: restarted batch job with reduced parallelism

description: Claim status update failed to sync to customer portal after adjuster approval
root_cause: Message queue consumer service crashed silently, messages backed up unprocessed
resolution: Restarted consumer service and added health check monitoring

description: Customer notification emails for policy renewal not sent, queue backing up
root_cause: Message queue consumer service crashed, same failure mode as INC-004
resolution: Applied same consumer restart fix, escalated for permanent monitoring fix

description: Underwriting risk scoring batch produced incorrect scores for a subset of commercial policies
root_cause: Third-party credit risk API returned malformed response, not caught by validation layer
resolution: Added response schema validation before scores are committed

description: New claim submissions rejected with generic validation error, no clear cause in logs
root_cause: Unknown - insufficient logging detail, root cause never fully confirmed
resolution: Temporary manual override applied by support team, root cause investigation deprioritized

description: Policy document generation batch failed for a small number of auto insurance policies
root_cause: PDF template engine ran out of memory processing an unusually large policy document
resolution: Increased memory allocation for the PDF generation service

description: Batch job commercial_policy_load failed, database connection pool exhausted during high concurrency load
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion, fourth occurrence of same underlying issue
resolution: Escalated for permanent fix: connection pool size increase deployed cluster-wide

description: Agent portal login failures reported by multiple regional offices simultaneously
root_cause: Identity provider certificate expired without automated renewal alert firing
resolution: Renewed certificate manually and added expiry monitoring alert 30 days in advance

description: Claims adjuster dashboard showing stale data, records not reflecting recent updates
root_cause: Cache invalidation job failed to trigger after database writes, serving stale cached data
resolution: Manually flushed cache and fixed the invalidation trigger condition

description: Auto insurance quote calculation returning inconsistent premiums for identical inputs
root_cause: Race condition in the rating engine when multiple rating factors update concurrently
resolution: Added locking around the rating factor update path, deployed hotfix

description: Batch job home_policy_renewal timed out, connection pool for policy database exhausted overnight
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion, related to nightly batch overlap
resolution: Same fix pattern as prior connection pool incidents, permanent pool size increase already partially rolled out

description: Claim payout batch job processed duplicate payments for a small set of claims
root_cause: Idempotency key check missing on retry logic after a transient network failure
resolution: Added idempotency key validation before payout execution, reconciled duplicate payments

description: Underwriting exception dashboard not loading, blank page reported by multiple underwriters
root_cause: Frontend build deployed with a broken JavaScript bundle reference
resolution: Rolled back to previous frontend build, fixed bundle reference in next release

description: Claims document upload feature failing for files larger than 10MB
root_cause: Reverse proxy request size limit set too low after a recent infrastructure change
resolution: Increased max request body size on the reverse proxy configuration

description: Commercial underwriting batch failed, connection pool for underwriting database exhausted during nightly run
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion, sixth occurrence, root cause well understood but permanent fix rollout incomplete
resolution: Manual restart with reduced concurrency as an interim fix pending full rollout

description: Customer complaint that policy cancellation confirmation was never received
root_cause: Message queue consumer for notification service crashed again
resolution: Restarted consumer, permanent monitoring fix from INC-005 escalation still pending full deployment

description: Fraud detection scoring service returning null scores for a subset of new claims submitted overnight
root_cause: Unknown - service logs show no errors, behavior not reproducible in staging, root cause unresolved
resolution: Manual review process activated for affected claims as a stopgap; investigation ongoing

description: Agent commission calculation batch produced negative commission values for a handful of policies
root_cause: Edge case in proration formula when a policy is cancelled and rewritten within the same billing cycle
resolution: Patched proration formula to handle same-cycle cancel-and-rewrite scenarios
